name: account-home
title: Account home
description: A bank account start page in Tiles: a payment card, the balance, a three-state dial and recent transactions.

props.name: data
props.type: { card: StackCard; balance: number; change: number; pace: number; budget: number; transactions: Transaction[]; categories?: Record<string, string> }
props.description: The card, balance, spending pace, budget, transactions and optional category names to show.

props.name: format
props.description: How amounts are formatted. Default euro with two decimals.

props.name: note
props.description: Footer text on the balance tile. Default "Example data."

props.name: today
props.description: "YYYY-MM-DD" of today, so the list reads "Today" and "Yesterday". Default the day of `now`.

props.name: now
props.description: The current time. Used for `today` when that is not given.

props.name: labels
props.type: { card?: string; balance?: string; pace?: string; paceCaption?: string; transactions?: string; budget?: string; zones?: [string, string, string] }
props.description: Visible text and screen reader text, with English defaults.

a11y.text: An h1 title (default "Account") with tiles named by their h2: card-stack with one card and hideAmount set, an inverted balance tile with BigNumber and DeltaPill from chart-kit, a three-zone dial (default Under, On track, Over) that is a read-only meter, and transaction-list limited to 5. See their notes. Tab stops come from card-stack and from the transaction-list show more button when there are more than 5 transactions.
